source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
After this model finishes its attacks in your Shooting phase or in the Fight phase, pick 1 enemy unit that at least 1 of those attacks hit. That unit stays poisoned for the rest of the battle.

As each Command phase begins, whoever's turn it is, roll 1 D6 for every poisoned enemy unit still on the battlefield: a 4+ inflicts D3 mortal wounds on it.
